name: Trending GitHub Repos Explorer
description: Navigates to GitHub trending repositories and extracts the README of the top repository.

steps.title: Navigate to GitHub Trending
steps.description: Access the trending repositories page on GitHub.

steps.title: Scroll to Load Repositories
steps.description: Scroll down to ensure all trending repositories are loaded.

steps.title: Click on Top Repository
steps.description: Select the top trending repository to view its details.

steps.title: Extract README Content
steps.description: Retrieve the README content of the selected repository.

steps.title: Export README Data
steps.description: Export the extracted README content for review.
